concept: A picture with a corner from the scale that fades in over the carve of the glass, and stays a quiet recess if it fails.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a bare img that pops in and shows the browser broken-image icon
default_to_avoid.why_not: a pop-in jumps the eye and a broken-image box looks like a bug on glass

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it; controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: the image takes the media corner inside a pane so its curve nests in the pane

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: it fades in at entry pace when it arrives, so it settles rather than pops

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: before it loads and if it fails, its space is the carve of the glass, a recess, never a white box

options: A fade in over the carve
variants.picked: A fade in over the carve
variants.reason: A settles (P4) and keeps a recess in the glass while waiting (P3). B jumps. C needs a second tiny image for every picture.

root.why: the image box, with the carve showing until the picture arrives

media.why: the media corner, nested inside a pane, the same in every theme and on every scene

inner.why: the inner corner for an image that fills a card edge to edge

none.why: no corner, for an image that runs to the edge of a page

cover.why: fills the box and crops, for covers and thumbnails

contain.why: shows the whole picture, for diagrams and product shots

data-state=loading.why: faint while loading, so the arrival reads as a fade in

data-state=error.why: a failed image stays a quiet recess with its alt text available

opacity.why: fades in at entry pace when the picture arrives
